plugins.description: Personal skills: pr-review (machine facts first, then the repo's own rules and a per-repo review profile, then one risk-first reading of the diff, then a skeptic per finding, then a decider per open question so the user is asked only what truly needs them), then a fix loop (fix test-first, prove, re-review, verify — once, or until green with /pr-review loop).
